about: The hare's walk: four poses of the body's own Walk, a lope keyed on the paw targets (each paw planted for 0.15 of the cycle and carried back 0.17 m: about 1.1 m of ground a cycle, the body's bob at 0.2 of the file's bound), side-on, down and up, at the kernel's walk of 190 ms a tile (HUNTING 2: a hare wanders at the walk). The cycle has time in the air, so it is rendered airborne (one floor a cycle). The foot-slide limit is the wolf's 2 px for a quadruped's four-pose loop. Four poses a loop, as the owner picked for the wolf (DECISIONS 2026-10-29).
